composition.name: Monolith Center
composition.scale: one oversized element, everything else small
composition.density: sparse — most of the viewport is empty
composition.hierarchy: single-point: one focus, no competing levels

signature.text: Every image is masked to the same irregular polygon derived from the logo

composition.name: Editorial Spread
composition.scale: oversized display type against modest body columns
composition.density: varied — columns, pull elements, deliberate gaps
composition.symmetry: magazine asymmetry; elements cross column boundaries
composition.hierarchy: display type first, decks and pulls second, body third
composition.ground: multi-column page the display type violates on purpose

signature.text: A visible baseline ruler runs down one edge and content demonstrably sits on it

composition.name: Marginalia
composition.scale: steady text column, small margin apparatus
composition.density: dense column beside an airy margin
composition.hierarchy: main column leads; margin annotates and cross-references
composition.ground: book page — the margin is working space, not padding

signature.text: Tables and rules use box-drawing characters as borders

composition.name: Fractured Grid
composition.scale: colliding scales — fragments at different sizes
composition.hierarchy: the collision point leads; layers order the rest
composition.ground: layers overlap the ground and each other
composition.dominantElement: the collision point where layers meet

signature.text: Headings interrupt their top border like a legend on a map frame

composition.name: Poster Bleed
composition.scale: one full-bleed image or letterform at viewport scale
composition.density: minimal copy pinned to edges and corners
composition.symmetry: edge-anchored, center deliberately vacant or occupied by the bleed
composition.hierarchy: the bleed is the message; text is caption-rank

signature.text: The layout grid becomes visible at exactly one moment (hover, load, or footer)

output.contract: The model justifies and executes this dealt hand — it does not re-choose. Rejected hand: re-deal with --reroll N+1; both deals stay recorded in used-dna.json. Pinned axes are user law — dealt around, never re-chosen.
